title: esport48 paper-eval checklist
hypothesis: `esport48` can eventually graduate from alert-only if its near-expiry esport alerts are liquid enough, not just noisy favorites/underdogs, and the subtype tags help separate signal from churn.
summary: Do not promote just because the alerts look intuitively sharp. This strategy needs evidence that the screener is surfacing executable mispricings, not last-minute esport chaos.
